description: Make every app the simulator launches get a camera, however it was launched — `expo start`, `react-native run-ios`, Xcode, a test runner. Use this when you are not the one starting the app, so `camera_launch` is not an option. It loads Buoy's library into every process in that simulator, SpringBoard included, so turn it off when finished.

action.description: Turn it on, off, or report the current state.

udid.description: Which simulator. Only needed when several are booted.

name: camera_zero_setup
